modes.name: Dorian
modes.description: Minor with raised 6th. Most common traditional mode.

modes.name: Aeolian (Natural Minor)
modes.description: Pure minor. Slow airs and laments.

forms.name: Jig
forms.description: Lively dance in compound duple meter.

forms.name: Reel
forms.description: Fast dance with continuous quaver motion.

forms.name: Polka
forms.description: Lively couple dance. Sliabh Luachra style.

forms.name: Strathspey
forms.description: Scottish dance with Scotch snap rhythm.

instruments.name: Fiddle
instruments.description: Violin played in folk style. Ornament-rich.

instruments.name: Tin Whistle
instruments.description: Simple metal flute. Key of D most common.

instruments.name: Bodhrán
instruments.description: Frame drum with stick. Tipper technique.

instruments.name: Uilleann Pipes
instruments.description: Irish bellows-blown bagpipes. Sweet and mellow.

instruments.name: Wooden Flute
instruments.description: Simple system wooden flute. Breathy tone.

instruments.name: Celtic Harp
instruments.description: Lever harp with metal strings. Ancient tradition.

ornaments.name: Cut
ornaments.description: Quick grace note above main note.

ornaments.name: Strike
ornaments.description: Quick grace note below main note.

ornaments.name: Slide
ornaments.description: Finger slide into note from below.

ornaments.name: Bend
ornaments.description: Pitch bend by embouchure or finger.
